body.cap: K&E’s vehicle torque sensor showcased at FIX 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: K&E (CEO Intaek Kang) participated in the 2024 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2024), held from October 23 to 26 at Daegu EXCO. The company, recognized for its precision press components, serves various industries, including automotive, mobile, and telecommunications, by leveraging advanced technologies like precision drawing and rigorous quality control systems.

K&E has built an integrated system encompassing mold design, component manufacturing, and SMT for electronic circuit boards, ensuring swift and accurate services. The company emphasizes organic collaboration within its corporate ecosystem to enhance customer satisfaction and production stability.

At FIX 2024, K&E introduced its line of vehicle torque sensors. These sensors minimize magnetic field interference caused by external magnetic fields and maintain consistent output values corresponding to rotational angles. This functionality improves reliability and performance, setting them apart from conventional torque sensors.

K&E also displayed USB Type-C sockets for mobile devices, which feature IP68-grade waterproof and dustproof durability. Designed with a seamless finish using advanced drawing techniques, these sockets align with industry trends while offering exceptional robustness.

Additionally, the company showcased 5G communication connectors tailored for cutting-edge smartphones and communication devices. K&E’s successful “Full Shield” technology has attracted development requests from leading corporations, further solidifying its position in the market.

A K&E representative stated, “We aim to become a key partner in the future mobility industry by supplying essential components that support sustainable and safe ecosystems. In parallel, we are expanding into EV battery component development to secure long-term growth.”

The representative added, “We are intensifying R&D and quality improvement efforts to enhance global competitiveness. By showcasing our current technological capabilities and ambitions at FIX 2024, we aim to boost our visibility and strengthen our foothold in domestic and international markets.”

FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
